title: mailparse::addrparse for quoted-comma display names
description: The hand-rolled split-on-comma address parser was incorrect for RFC 5322: 'Smith, John' <j@example.com> split into two tokens, discarding both. addrparse handles quoting and address groups correctly. The test added (quoted_comma_in_display_name) verifies the fix. Do not revert to split-on-comma.
